model: ViconNet Shadow Elite Recording Server (2U, RAID 5)

outputs: 1x mini DP, 1920 x 1200 (WUXGA) max using Nvidia graphics

storage.built_in: 96, 144 or 192 TB gross (79.2, 118 or 158.4 TB usable), RAID 5, depending on model

features: 1x RJ-45 iDRAC port; iDRAC remote management
Rear panel I/O: 1x USB 2.0, 1x USB 3.0, 1x VGA; front panel: 1x USB 2.0, 1x micro USB for iDRAC, 1x VGA
Datasheet camera-to-NVR ratio at 25/30 fps: 120 cameras per RAID drive at D1 and below, 80 at 2 MP, 30 at 8 MP, 10 at 12 MP
notes: Datasheet prints NERA-2U118TF-N02; product page prints NERA-2U118F-N02.
Datasheet gives 400 W typical and 550 W maximum power consumption.
Datasheet gives 2x 480 GB M.2 OS SSDs (RAID-1); product page gives 250 GB SSDs (RAID-1). OS drive size left out.
No camera channel limit is stated for these models.
